form.titleHint: Fill at least one; the other language falls back to it.
form.incrementHint: Each bid must be at least the current price plus this amount.
form.insuranceHint: Bidders need this wallet balance to bid. It is not charged. Use 0 for none.
form.mainImageHint: Required. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
form.galleryHint: Optional. Up to 30 photos in total.
form.documentsHint: PDF or Office files shown on the lot page, up to 10 MB each.
form.specsHint: Rows shown in the lot's details table, such as quantity, location or pickup.
form.isActiveHint: Hidden auctions are only visible to you and administrators.
form.frozen: This auction has {count, plural, one {# bid} other {# bids}}, so the starting price, increment, insurance, start time and country can't change. You can still extend the end time.
form.publisherHint: Leave empty for a platform-owned auction.
